name: Esqueleto Explosivo 2
review:
Esqueleto Explosivo 2 brings back the skeleton mariachis on 5 reels with 99 ways. Explosivo Wilds blow up symbols, Mucho Multipliers rise with each drop, and dropping symbols keep wins flowing.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 5,000x cap and a 96.13% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
